title: Hyperliquid Perps Integration + Base Builder Code Registration

what_happened.task: Integrate Hyperliquid perpetual futures as a zero-gas execution venue + register wallets with Base builder code API for ERC-8021 attribution
what_happened.context: User wanted to leverage Hyperliquid for capital-efficient trading parallel to on-chain strategies, and maximize Base chain integration
steps_taken: Generated dedicated API wallet (non-custodial, no withdrawal perms)
Implemented HyperliquidExecutor with full capital protection suite
Integrated as fallback in fastlane_worker when on-chain execution fails
Registered both wallets with Base builder code API
Wired attribution into executor.py 1inch + Flashbots paths

what_went_well: Hyperliquid SDK was straightforward to integrate
Capital preservation defaults (2x leverage, $25 max, 3% SL) are appropriately conservative
Symbol normalization (WETH→ETH, WBTC→BTC) prevented silent order failures
Base builder code registration was a simple one-time API call
ERC-8021 attribution is a zero-cost append to tx data — no gas overhead
what_went_wrong: SSH session timeout caused initial deploy delay
git push hung multiple times requiring patience (likely SSH key negotiation)

patterns_extracted.description: Hyperliquid uses unwrapped symbols (ETH not WETH, BTC not WBTC). Must normalize before placing orders.
Leveraged perps require MULTI-LAYER protection: per-trade risk cap, daily loss circuit breaker, funding rate check, gem score gate, max exposure cap, max concurrent positions
Base chain transactions should include ERC-8021 builder code suffix for attribution tracking. Register wallets once, then append data suffix to every Base tx's data field.
New execution venues (Hyperliquid, Solana, etc.) should run as isolated parallel systems with their own wallets, risk limits, and circuit breakers. Never share state with on-chain execution.

key_directives: PROTECT THE CAPITAL — never risk more than necessary
PICK ONLY WINNERS — 80+ gem score gate for Hyperliquid
Small incremental profits are fine — don't swing for home runs
Register Base builder codes for incentive eligibility
